title: ORASR: Operational Reasoning-Action Safety Routing for Clinical Decision Support
description: An operational reasoning-action safety routing component that selects safe clinical action pathways under uncertainty. It receives a risk and action request, checks pathway constraints, selects a route (FAST, NORMAL, or SAFE) with a safety override on constraint violation, and records the reasoning and audit outputs.
